text:
Noah G: Received invoice PL-3342 from Polaris Analytics for $28,400. OCR matched PO PO-779900 but the invoice lists the vendor legal entity as "Polaris Analytics UK Ltd" while the PO and contract reference "Polaris Analytics, Inc. (US)". AP blocked auto-route due to legal entity mismatch.

Sana R: Oof. Is the tax registration/VAT ID present? Which remit-to bank?

Noah G: Invoice shows VAT GB-998877 and UK bank details. PO was issued to Polaris Analytics, Inc. (US) with EIN 12-3456789 and USD wiring. The contract metadata in ProcureLink has vendor_entity = "Polaris Analytics, Inc.".

finance-bot: Automated alert: PL-3342 flagged as "vendor_entity_mismatch". Suggested actions: 1) request vendor reissue to the entity on the PO, 2) get procurement confirmation for accept-as-is if entity change is allowed, or 3) route to Legal Ops for review if cross-border invoicing affects tax/treaty.

AP Queue: From AP: Payment hold applied. Cannot auto-match to PO while legal entity != PO vendor. If vendor confirms that Polaris UK is the billed entity and provides a signed addendum to the contract, AP can accept reissued invoice and route for new approver. Otherwise vendor must reissue to Polaris Analytics, Inc. Please escalate to procurement and legal.

Polaris Billing: Hi Noah  sorry for the confusion. Our finance team routed the invoice through our UK subsidiary for local VAT handling. We can: A) reissue invoice to Polaris Analytics, Inc. (US) with no VAT and USD wire details, keeping same invoice number with suffix PL-3342-US, or B) provide a signed cross-charge/service agreement and supplier attestation from our legal team to bill via the UK entity. Which is required on your end?

Noah G: Procurement prefers option A for speed (reissue to US entity). We need the invoice in USD with US EIN shown, and the PO number in text. Keep invoice date the same.

Legal Ops: @Noah G @Polaris Billing quick note: if Polaris insists on UK billing, Legal needs the signed addendum before AP can release payment due to tax withholding and 1099 implications. We can fast-track review if Polaris provides the addendum PDF and a contact email for legal. Otherwise advise vendor to reissue to US entity.

Sana R: If vendor reissues to US entity, AP will accept and auto-match to PO-779900. Steps we'll perform: ```1) Vendor uploads PL-3342-US.pdf to portal. 2) OCR verifies PO-779900 and EIN 12-3456789. 3) ProcureLink auto-match -> route to approver on PO.``` If vendor chooses addendum route, flag will remain until Legal signs off.

Polaris Billing: Understood. We'll reissue PL-3342-US (same base invoice number with -US suffix) and upload within 24 hours. We'll include PO-779900 as plain text and US wiring/EIN. If Legal needs the addendum instead, we'll also attach it.

finance-bot: Action recorded: PL-3342 set to on_hold/vendor_action. Due date: 1 business day (2064520000). Assigned tasks: await reissued invoice or legal addendum.

AP Queue: Noted. Placing note on PO-779900: "Vendor invoice PL-3342 billed to UK entity; awaiting reissue to US entity or legal addendum. Payment on hold."

Noah G: Thanks. I'll follow up with procurement and monitor upload. Polaris  pls paste portal link when you upload so we can auto-match quickly.

Polaris Billing: Uploaded PL-3342-US.pdf here: https://files.polaris.example/PL-3342-US.pdf. It shows EIN 12-3456789, USD wiring, and PO-779900 in text.

finance-bot: File received. OCR matched PO-779900 and EIN. Suggested auto-match to PO-779900 and route to approver.

AP Queue: Auto-match performed and invoice routed for approval. Approver on PO notified. Hold cleared pending approver sign-off.

Noah G: Approved the match once approver signs. Closing thread after payment clears.
